tips.title: Outings
tips.text: Entertainment averaged AED 1,520 a month over the last 3 months, AED 320 over its AED 1,200 budget. Keeping to the budget frees about AED 3,840 a year.
facts: Over the budget: AED 320 a month, AED 3,840 a year.

tips.title: Subscription
tips.text: You pay AED 59 a month for Streaming bundle. If nobody uses it much, cancelling it saves AED 708 a year.
facts: Subscription: Streaming bundle, AED 59 a month.
Cancelling it saves AED 708 a year.

tips.title: Rent
tips.text: Rent is 29% of the income you plan on, AED 120,000 a year. Compare other flats before the contract renews.
facts: Rent: AED 120,000 a year, about AED 10,000 a month.
Income you plan on: AED 34,500 a month.
